items.statement: The selected validated model either supports close agreement with the experimental molecular geometry or transparently demonstrates why the bounded investigation cannot establish it.
items.expected: A completion conclusion is tied to reported metrics and scope, or a truthful bounded-failure conclusion is tied to diagnostics.
